**Job Description \& Summary**

At PwC, our people in data and analytics engineering focus on leveraging advanced technologies and techniques to design and develop robust data solutions for clients. They play a crucial role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision\-making and driving business growth.
  

  

Those in intelligent automation at PwC will focus on conducting process mining, designing next generation small\- and large\-scale automation solutions, and implementing intelligent process automation, robotic process automation and digital workflow solutions to help clients achieve operational efficiencies and reduce costs.
Why PWC


At PwC, you will be part of a vibrant community of solvers that leads with trust and creates distinctive outcomes for our clients and communities. This purpose\-led and values\-driven work, powered by technology in an environment that drives innovation, will enable you to make a tangible impact in the real world. We reward your contributions, support your wellbeing, and offer inclusive benefits, flexibility programmes and mentorship that will help you thrive in work and life. Together, we grow, learn, care, collaborate, and create a future of infinite experiences for each other. Learn more about us .


At PwC, we believe in providing equal employment opportunities, without any discrimination on the grounds of gender, ethnic background, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, religion or other beliefs, perceived differences and status protected by law. We strive to create an environment where each one of our people can bring their true selves and contribute to their personal growth and the firm’s growth. To enable this, we have zero tolerance for any discrimination and harassment based on the above considerations.


**Job Description \& Summary:**

A career within PwC India as an a gentic automation developer who will combine technical automation expertise with business process analysis skills to drive digital transformation initiatives. This role focuses on developing comprehensive process maps, models, and generating actionable process intelligence insights using industry\-leading automation and process mining tools.  



**Responsibilities:**

**Process Analysis \& Design**

* Analyze existing business processes and identify automation opportunities
* Develop detailed process maps, workflows, and process models using industry\-standard tools
* Conduct process discovery sessions with stakeholders across various business units
* Create comprehensive process documentation including AS\-IS and TO\-BE process flows
* Design optimized processes that align with automation capabilities and business objectives
**Automation Development**

* Design and implement automation solutions based on process analysis findings
* Collaborate with technical teams to translate business requirements into automated workflows
* Support the development and deployment of automation tools and technologies
* Ensure automation solutions align with established process models and business requirements
**Process** **Automation** **Intelligence \& Insights**

* Extract and analyze process data to generate actionable business insights
* Develop process performance metrics and KPIs to measure efficiency improvements
* Create executive dashboards and reports to communicate process analytics findings
* Identify process bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for optimization
* Provide data\-driven recommendations for process improvements and automation initiatives
**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand process requirements and pain points
* Facilitate workshops and training sessions on process optimization and automation tools
* Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership and project teams
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful process automation implementations
**Mandatory skill sets:**

**Process Automation \& Intelligence Development technical** **Skills:**

* Process Automation and Intelligence tool experience with: Uipath Process gold, Automation anywhere process discovery Celonis , Signavio , ARIS
* Other Technology experience: Strong ETL Knowledge with API integration and system integration
**Communication and stakeholder management:**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience creating executive\-level presentations and reports
* Strong documentation skills with attention to detail
* Ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical audiences
**Preferred skill sets:**

* Previous experience in process transformation or digital transformation projects
* Experience in enterprise environments (SAP, Oracle) with complex business processes
* Knowledge of industry\-specific processes (Finance, Supply Chain, HR, Customer Service)
* Experience with process mining tools ( ProcessGold , Celonis , Signavio , Aris)
* Knowledge of RPA tools (UiPath, Blue Prism, Automation Anywhere)
* Familiarity with workflow automation platforms . Basic understanding of database querying (SQL) and data visualization tools (Power BI)
**Years of experience** **required:**

10\-20 years


**Education qualification:**

\`Any

title: HR Intern
description:
#### **Job Overview**


We are seeking an enthusiastic and competent HR Intern to join our firm. As an HR Intern, you will provide assistance to our HR department in everyday operations. You will assist in various tasks including payroll, recruitment, selection, orientation and employee training and development. You will assist in updating our employee records with new hire information, screen resumes and schedule interviews. You will help in organizing and planning our HR approaches, policies and procedures.


If you think you are capable to start your career in Human Resources, we would like to meet you!


#### **Responsibilities**

* Update our internal databases with new employee data including contact details and employment forms.
* Collect payroll information such as hours of work done by an employee, details of bank accounts etc.
* Assist in screening forms and resumes of applicants.
* Plan and schedule interviews with candidates.
* Manage job advertisements on job portals and social networks.
* Create reports on the HR\-related process when required.
* Address queries and issues of workers when required.
* Review and distribute company strategies by hard copies (e.g. notice board, brochures) or in digital formats (e.g. email, posts on social networks/forums/company website).
* Assist the HR team in organizing careers fairs and special events.

#### **Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management.
* Knowledge of database systems, HRIS and ATS.
* Proficient in MS Office.
* Basic understanding of labor legislation (Occupational safety and health, Anti\-discrimination law, National Labor Relations Act etc).
* Excellent planning and organizational skills.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

**​Communication:** Fluent in English and Hindi (Knowledge of Indori/local slang is a major plus for connecting with our ground staff!).

**​Education:** Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA/BBA in Human Resources or a related field.

​Real Impact: You aren’t just filing papers; you are helping build a green\-energy fleet from the ground up.

​Mentorship: Work directly with the leadership team in a flat hierarchy.

​Certificate \& Letter of Recommendation: To boost your career post\-internship.

​Flexibility: A dynamic work environment with plenty of room to experiment with your ideas.

title: Manager, Communications & Employer Brand, People Experience - Global Capability Center
description:
Location: Gurugram, India  

Date Posted: Mar 22, 2026

  

**Description**


**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
**The Team**
The Communications Manager supports the Global People Office (GPO) People Experience (PX) team by delivering clear, consistent, and well\-executed communications that strengthen the employee experience and reinforce the firm’s people strategy. This role blends hands\-on execution with coordination, analytics, and continuous improvement across internal, external, and social channels. The Communications Manager partners closely with GPO and cross\-functional stakeholders to manage intake, prioritize requests, and ensure communications are timely, accurate, engaging, and easy to consume.
**How you will contribute**
1\. Communications Execution \& Operations:* Maintain and update core GPO communications trackers, including trackers for campaigns, call discussions, and ongoing initiatives.
* Lead and manage the New Managing Director (MD) email process, ensuring accurate content, timely delivery, appropriate approvals, and alignment with GPO messaging.
* Partner with stakeholders to review incoming requests, confirm scope, and prioritize work based on business needs, timelines, and available capacity.
* Populate and maintain campaign briefs, ensuring objectives, audiences, timelines, governance, and approvals are clearly documented.
* Populate PX presentation slides for Leadership, ensuring consistency in messaging, formatting, and visuals.
* Create agendas and meeting summaries for recurring GPO meetings, capturing key decisions, actions, risks, and follow\-ups.
* Provide flexible support for PX special projects as business priorities evolve.


2\. Creative Channel Management:* Serve as Creative Lead for GPO communications, owning imagery, templates, formats, and banners to ensure visual consistency and alignment with brand standards.
* Manage the Instagram intake process, ensuring all required components are received, drafting copy, selecting photos, and routing content through approvals.
* Schedule approved social media posts and share live links with requestors to help boost engagement and visibility.
* Monitor external platforms (e.g., Glassdoor, Indeed, Fishbowl) for negative, sensitive, or reputationally impactful commentary, escalating themes and insights to appropriate stakeholders.


3\. Analytics, Insights \& Optimization:* Own and maintain the GPO analytics dashboard, tracking performance across channels and campaigns.
* Analyze survey data, engagement metrics, and sentiment signals to identify trends and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Conduct competitor analysis and A\&M sentiment analysis related to the employer brand, summarizing insights and opportunities for improvement.
* Apply learnings from analytics and feedback to continuously refine messaging, formats, and processes.


4\. Technology, Tools \& Process Improvement:* Test, maintain, and support ongoing improvements to the GPO AI tool, ensuring accuracy, usability, and appropriate governance.
* Serve as the point of contact (POC) for GPO creative requests, coordinating inputs, timelines, approvals, and responses.
* Support the build\-out and ongoing refinement of internal and external communications intake and approval processes to improve efficiency, clarity, and consistency.
* Demonstrate adaptability
**Qualifications*** 5\+ years supporting internal, external, and social communications within a corporate, professional services, or HR\-focused environment.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Excellent writing, editing, and content development skills, with strong attention to detail and quality.
* Comfort working with analytics, dashboards, survey data, and performance metrics to inform communications decisions.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive, confidential, or reputationally impactful content.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to provide guidance rather than simply execute requests.
* Awareness of global audiences and cultural considerations when supporting people\-related communications.
* Flexibility and willingness to jump in where needed to support evolving GPO priorities.

**Your journey at A\&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.  


**Inclusive Diversity**
-----------------------


A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who can positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M’s core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are the main reasons our people love working at A\&M. Inclusive Diversity means we embrace diversity, and we foster inclusiveness, encouraging everyone to bring their whole self to work each day. It runs through how we recruit, develop employees, conduct business, support clients, and partner with vendors. It is the A\&M way.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------


It is Alvarez \& Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. .


**Unsolicited Resumes from Third\-Party Recruiters**
----------------------------------------------------


Please note that as per A\&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A\&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

**Role Overview**

The **HR Manager** will be responsible for **end\-to\-end human resources management**, with a strong focus on **recruitment, policy formulation, HR systems, compliance, and people standards**. This is an **office\-based role**, supporting both **corporate and project teams**, ensuring consistent HR practices across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

* Lead **end\-to\-end recruitment** for office and site\-based roles (engineering, project, commercial, support functions)
* Coordinate with **recruitment agencies**, consultants, and internal stakeholders
* Manage **job descriptions, sourcing, screening, interviews, and offer rollouts**
* Maintain recruitment trackers and hiring metrics (TAT, cost per hire, attrition analysis)

**2\. HR Policies \& Governance**

* Develop, implement, and update **HR policies, manuals, and SOPs**
* Ensure consistency of HR policies across **corporate office and project sites**
* Handle policy communication, implementation, and adherence
* Benchmark HR practices with industry standards

**3\. Performance Management**

* Design and manage **performance appraisal systems (KPIs, OKRs, annual reviews)**
* Support leadership in **goal setting, performance reviews, and feedback cycles**
* Drive a culture of accountability and performance orientation

**4\. Employee Engagement \& Culture**

* Drive **employee engagement initiatives**, communication programs, and feedback mechanisms
* Address employee concerns, grievances, and disciplinary matters
* Support leadership in building a **professional, ethical, and collaborative work culture**

**5\. Compliance \& Statutory Management**

* Ensure compliance with **labour laws and statutory requirements**, including:
* EPF, ESIC, PT, Gratuity
* CLRA, Shops \& Establishments Act
* Coordinate audits and statutory inspections
* Maintain accurate employee records and documentation

**6\. Payroll \& HR Operations**

* Coordinate payroll processing with finance / external vendors
* Ensure accurate attendance, leave, and payroll data
* Oversee onboarding, exits, final settlements, and documentation

**7\. Training \& Development**

* Identify training needs for technical and soft skills
* Coordinate induction and onboarding programs
* Support leadership development and succession planning initiatives

**8\. HR Systems \& Reporting**

* Implement and manage **HRMIS / HR systems**
* Maintain HR dashboards and MIS reports for management review
* Track attrition, manpower strength, recruitment status, and productivity metrics

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong understanding of **HR operations, recruitment, and compliance**
* Ability to create and enforce **policies, processes, and standards**
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and coordination skills
* Strong problem\-solving and conflict\-handling abilities
* High integrity and confidentiality

**Qualification \& Experience**

* MBA / PGDM in **Human Resources** or equivalent
* **8–12 years** of experience in HR roles, preferably in **construction / infrastructure / EPC sectors**
* Strong exposure to **recruitment, HR operations, and compliance**
* Experience handling both **office and site manpower** is preferred

**Why Join Suntech Infra Solutions**

* Opportunity to build and standardize HR systems in a growing organization
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision\-making
* Professional, performance\-driven work environment
* Long\-term career growth opportunities

**A contract has been executed between the world’s highest\-rated university, QS \#1 — MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology), Boston, USA — and SEU, Georgia, Europe \| Atmia Education, India.**

We are entering a phase of **massive expansion** with a long\-term growth vision of **1300\+ Crores**, and we are now looking for the **country’s best HR talent** to join this mission.

**We are looking for serious HR professionals who can build winning teams, support large\-scale expansion, and become true growth partners in our journey. If you believe you are among the best.**

Become part of one of the fastest\-growing international education platforms.

If you are confident that you can attract top talent, close strong candidates, build systems, and support rapid expansion, we want to hear from you.

**Full Job Description**

We are hiring a **Senior HR Leader / Talent Acquisition Head / HR Business Partner** to lead aggressive hiring and support rapid business growth across counselling, sales, admissions, operations, support, marketing, and leadership functions.

The ideal candidate must have a strong command over **recruitment, hiring strategy, talent acquisition, people management, and growth\-driven HR execution**.

You should be capable of helping us build strong teams, improve hiring quality, reduce hiring delays, and bring in professionals who can contribute directly to revenue, conversion, service quality, and expansion.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment and talent acquisition across departments
* Hire top\-performing talent for counselling, sales, admissions, operations, marketing, and leadership roles
* Build aggressive hiring pipelines to support expansion plans
* Source, screen, shortlist, interview, evaluate, and close quality candidates
* Coordinate salary discussions, offer rollouts, joining follow\-ups, and onboarding
* Work directly with management on manpower planning and expansion hiring strategy
* Build strong hiring systems, recruitment workflows, and reporting structures
* Improve recruitment quality, speed of closure, and retention of selected candidates
* Ensure strong cultural fit, communication quality, and ownership mindset in every hire
* Strengthen employer branding so top candidates see us as a preferred place to work
* Support the creation of a disciplined, ethical, performance\-driven work culture
* Maintain proper recruitment records, trackers, reports, and HR documentation
* Contribute directly to business growth by ensuring the right talent is hired at the right time

**Candidate Requirements**

* Proven experience in **HR / Recruitment / Talent Acquisition / People Operations**
* Strong experience hiring for **sales, counselling, admissions, or target\-driven teams**
* Excellent interview judgement and talent assessment ability
* Strong communication, negotiation, and closing skills
* Ability to identify high\-potential candidates quickly and accurately
* Strong execution ability and ownership mindset
* Business\-minded and growth\-oriented personality
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, expansion\-focused environment
* Strong follow\-up discipline and result\-driven approach
* Comfortable working closely with founders / senior leadership
* Experience in education, overseas education, EdTech, services, or multi\-branch businesses will be preferred
* Familiarity with job portals, hiring tools, interview coordination, and recruitment reporting preferred

**What Makes This Opportunity Different**

* Association with a high\-credibility, fast\-growing education group
* Large\-scale expansion plans across India and international markets
* Opportunity to work directly with leadership
* High\-impact role with real visibility and growth potential
* Chance to build teams that directly drive admissions, business growth, and expansion
* Platform to grow into a major HR leadership role

**Who Should Apply**

Apply only if you are:

* serious about growth
* highly confident in hiring and talent acquisition
* capable of building teams at scale
* strong in execution, ownership, and follow\-up
* ready to work in an ambitious, high\-performance environment

**Compensation**

**Best in industry** for the right candidate.

Graduate (B.Tech, B.Com, BBA, BA, etc.), MBA preferred

**About House of EdTech**

**House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP)** is a high\-growth, multi\-entity EdTech organization focused on delivering **large\-scale, outcome\-driven professional education** across high\-impact domains including **Artificial Intelligence, Finance, Data, Product Management, and Business Skills**.

Founded by **Aditya Goenka \- Founder @ Be10x \& Office Master \| Enabling People Upskill Themselves \| LinkedIn)** and **Aditya Kachave \- Be10x \| LinkedIn),** **IIT Kharagpur alumni**, the organization has rapidly emerged as one of India’s most dynamic EdTech groups by combining **cutting\-edge curriculum, practitioner\-led training, and performance\-driven execution**. With a strong learner\-first philosophy and deep expertise in digital education delivery, House of EdTech enables working professionals and entrepreneurs to **upskill, increase productivity, and unlock measurable career and income growth**.

Today, the organization:

* **Serves over 5 million learners** across India and global markets
* Operates at an **annual recurring revenue (ARR) exceeding ₹350 crore**
* Employs **1,000\+ professionals** across sales, marketing, tech, product, and operations
* Maintains a **strong on\-ground presence in Pune and Kolkata**, supported by pan\-India digital reach

**Diversified Brand Portfolio**

House of EdTech operates a **strategically diversified portfolio of category\-leading education brands**, each addressing distinct learner needs and professional outcomes:

* **Be10x** ()Focused on practical AI tools and productivity solutions that help professionals work smarter and faster using real\-world AI applications.
* **Office Master** ()Specializes in advanced MS Excel, Power BI, and Office productivity programs designed for business and data professionals.
* **AI for Techies** ()Caters to technical professionals seeking hands\-on AI, Python, and SQL skills for accelerated career growth in tech and analytics roles.
* **Dr. Finance** ()Delivers structured personal finance education, enabling individuals to make informed decisions around saving, investing, and wealth creation.
* **Profit Uni** ()Provides applied stock market and trading education, focusing on practical strategies, risk management, and consistent profitability.
* **Springpad** ()Offers specialized programs in analytics and business intelligence, empowering learners with job\-ready, insight\-driven skills.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic **Talent Acquisition Executive / Senior Talent Acquisition Executive** to join our HR team in Kolkata. In this role, you will be responsible for end\-to\-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and offer management. This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about talent acquisition to work in a high\-growth EdTech environment and contribute to building world\-class teams.

**Key ResponsibilitiesTalent Sourcing \& Strategy**

* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies to attract top candidates
* Utilize multiple channels such as job portals, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and professional networks to source candidates
* Identify new and creative ways to reach out to potential candidates
* Research and implement innovative recruiting techniques
* Leverage employer branding to attract quality talent
* Create compelling job postings and recruitment advertisements

**Candidate Screening \& Shortlisting**

* Review resumes and applications to identify the best talent
* Conduct initial screening calls to evaluate candidates' skills, experience, and culture fit
* Assess candidate qualifications against job requirements
* Maintain timely and professional communication with all applicants
* Shortlist candidates efficiently to move them through the hiring funnel
* Evaluate both technical skills and cultural alignment

**Interview Coordination \& Process Management**

* Schedule interviews and coordinate between candidates and hiring managers
* Manage end\-to\-end interview logistics and communications
* Gather and document interview feedback to facilitate smooth decision\-making
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process
* Track candidate progress through recruitment stages
* Follow up with candidates and provide timely updates

**Building \& Maintaining Talent Pipelines**

* Proactively build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for future hiring needs
* Engage with passive candidates and develop long\-term relationships with potential hires
* Create talent pools segmented by role, skills, and experience level
* Keep track of industry hiring trends and market conditions
* Nurture candidate relationships for future opportunities
* Stay updated on salary benchmarks and competitive landscape

**Employer Branding \& Candidate Experience**

* Represent the company in a professional and engaging manner
* Actively contribute to enhancing the employer brand by ensuring a positive candidate experience
* Promote House of EdTech as a great place to work through social media, networking events, and recruitment campaigns
* Showcase company culture and values to attract the right talent
* Gather candidate feedback to improve recruitment experience
* Participate in job fairs, campus placements, and networking events

**Recruitment Analytics \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate recruitment data and generate reports on key hiring metrics
* Use data\-driven insights to optimize recruitment strategies and improve hiring efficiency
* Track metrics such as time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, source effectiveness, and conversion rates
* Provide regular updates to leadership on recruitment status
* Utilize Applicant Tracking System (ATS) effectively
* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

**Required Skills \& QualificationsMust\-Have Skills \& Experience**

* **Experience** – 1–2 years in Talent Acquisition or a similar HR role
* **Recruitment Knowledge** – Strong knowledge of recruitment processes, sourcing strategies, and hiring best practices
* **Communication** – Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* **Multitasking** – Ability to manage multiple job openings and prioritize tasks effectively
* **Technical Proficiency** – Proficiency in using job portals, LinkedIn, and applicant tracking systems (ATS)

* **Relationship Building** – Ability to build rapport with candidates and hiring managers
* **Organization** – Excellent organizational and time management skills
* **Adaptability** – Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* **Attention to Detail** – Meticulous in candidate screening and documentation

**Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have)**

* Knowledge of HR software and recruitment tools

* Exposure to technical recruitment

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Core Roles \& Responsibilities1\. CAD Modeling and Drafting

This is the "bread and butter" of a junior designer. You will spend a significant portion of your time creating digital blueprints.

* **3D Modeling:** Developing detailed 3D parts and assemblies using software like SolidWorks, CATIA, or Creo.
* **2D Technical Drawings:** Converting 3D models into 2D shop drawings with proper views, sections, and annotations.
* **GD\&T Application:** Applying **Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing** to ensure parts fit together correctly during assembly.

2\. Design Documentation \& Management

Engineering is as much about the "paper trail" as it is about the hardware.

* **BOM Creation:** Maintaining the **Bill of Materials** (BOM), ensuring every nut, bolt, and custom part is accounted for.
* **Engineering Change Notices (ECN):** Documenting modifications made to existing designs to improve performance or reduce costs.
* **Technical Reports:** Assisting in writing manuals or assembly instructions for the manufacturing floor.

3\. Analysis and Validation

Before a part is made, you have to prove it won't fail.

* **FEA Support:** Performing basic **Finite Element Analysis** to check for stress points or deformations under load.
* **Tolerance Stack\-up:** Calculating how small variations in part sizes might affect the final assembly.
* **Prototyping:** Working with 3D printers or CNC shops to create physical samples for testing.

4\. Collaboration and Manufacturing Support

You act as the bridge between an idea and a physical object.

* **DFM/DFA:** Learning to design for **Manufacturability and Assembly**, ensuring parts aren't unnecessarily difficult or expensive to build.
* **Vendor Coordination:** Communicating with suppliers to source standard components (like bearings or motors) and checking their specifications.
* **Cross\-functional Meetings:** Sitting in on design reviews with senior engineers to learn how to defend your design choices.

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.**Manager \- GFS Service Management**
Hello. We’re Haleon. A new, world\-leading, and fast\-moving consumer healthcare company. Shaped by all who join us. Together, we’re improving everyday health for billions of people, by growing and innovating our global portfolio of category\-leading brands – including Crocin, Eno, Iodex, Otrivin and Centrum in India – through a unique combination of deep human understanding and trusted science. What’s more, we’re achieving it in a company that we’re in control of. In an environment that we’re cocreating. And a culture that’s uniquely ours. Care to join us. It isn’t a question.
This is an exciting time to join and help shape the future of the world’s newest and largest consumer healthcare company, that’s 100% focused on everyday health. Come and be part of something special.
Our Haleon Global Capability Centre (GCC), located in Bengaluru, India is rapidly expanding with exciting new positions being created in multiple functions.
At Haleon GCC we bring global value to our organisation, delivering complex enterprise solutions while driving digital transformation and innovation. The Finance, Digital \& Technology, HR and Procurement functions are co\-located, and work with colleagues and partners around the world. The increasing range of activities and roles based in the GCC will offer you great potential for career progression and take part in shaping the future of the GCC.**What This Role Delivers?**
The Manager, GFS Service Management, is responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end performance, governance, and contractual compliance of Global Finance Services (GFS) outsourced partners as well as GFS operational teams. The role drives operational excellence, performance insights, vendor management, risk management and forward\-looking decision support for GFS leadership, ensuring alignment with Haleon’s strategic and operational goals.
This role also plays a critical part in strengthening service performance visibility, driving accountability across internal and external partners, and enabling continuous improvement across GFS operations.**Key Responsibilities**
In terms of the role, you can expect the GFS Service Management to undertake the following:
1\.Contract Management* Ensure successful contract execution by overseeing timely and within\-budget completion of all deliverables and proactively resolving risks or disputes.
* Serve as the single point of contact between the business and vendor for Service Management discussions.
* Own the third party Contract Change Request process and governance, ensuring clarity and adherence.
* Provide support to the GFS LT \& ELT by interpreting contractual clauses with clear business impact assessments, in partnership with Procurement
* Identify and mitigate contractual risks, ensuring full compliance.
* Review and challenge vendor KPI reporting to ensure alignment with contractual definitions and calculations.
* Drive adoption of standardised contract governance practices across regions to ensure consistency.


2\.Performance Management \& Governance* Actively review and monitor GFS performance, including Genpact performance and GFS Operational teams, ensuring visibility and accountability.
* Continuously evolve GFS Management Review Boards \- refining meeting structures, inputs, and outputs.
* Support restructuring the GFS scorecard and aligning metrics with OMP (Operational Master Plan) goals.
* Drive performance conversations proactively between governance meetings.
* Ensure the new Genpact contract constructs deliver performance and productivity outcomes.
* Maintain full visibility into Genpact billings, exceptions, Change Requests, productivity, and R\&R mechanisms.
* Integrate billing, CRs, productivity, and reward mechanisms into monthly performance meetings.
* Collaborate with Contracting Lead on reviews and provoke targeted value discussions.
* Ensure stakeholders understand how to leverage contractual constructs to maximize benefits.
* Reassess KPIs quarterly or earlier if deviations persist for 3 consecutive months.
* Drive productivity assessments every 6 months with documented commitments.
* Introduce structured root‑cause analysis frameworks to strengthen operational performance insights.


3\.VOC (Voice Of Customer) monitoring* Own the VOC process including communications, distribution, consolidation, and action planning (Between BU and GFS ; between GFS and Genpact)


GFS Governance* Issue monthly GFS dashboards with root\-cause analysis and leadership\-level summaries.
* Evolve reporting from transactional to forward\-looking insights and recommendations.
* Establish standard reporting templates to ensure consistent storytelling across all service lines.

**Risk \& RAID Governance*** Manage JIRA GFS RAID access requests and maintain governance hygiene.
* Facilitate periodic risk review conversations across GFS stakeholders.

**Qualifications \& Skills*** Minimum 8 years of relevant experience
* Experience working in outsourced or hybrid operating models preferred.
* Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to translate data into insights.
* Demonstrated experience in Service Management, Vendor Management, or PMO roles within a global environment
* Demonstrate the ability to work autonomously and effectively establish and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and a problem‑solving mindset.
* Capable of effectively planning for and managing multiple competing demands and priorities.
* Possesses a comprehensive understanding of steps necessary to initiate, implement, and engage in a significant organisational change effort within a matrix environment.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve results in a complex global setting and effectively solve intricate business and process challenges.
* Experience in collaborating with various internal teams and third‑party stakeholders.
* Proficient in making informed and decisive decisions.
* Ability to drive operational excellence through structured governance and performance improvement practices.
* Strong communication, vendor management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Advanced Excel, PowerBI and performance analytics capability.
* Project and change management expertise (certification preferred).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and navigate complex global ecosystems

description:
Job Description: Hotel Manager

Position OverviewWe are looking for an experienced, dynamic Hotel Manager to lead the overall operations of our \[3\-5 star / boutique / luxury] hotel. As the key leader on property, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional guest experiences, driving operational efficiency, maximizing revenue, and building a high\-performing team. This is a hands\-on leadership role that demands strong business acumen, people skills, and a passion for hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee all hotel departments (Front Office, Housekeeping, Food \& Beverage, Sales, Maintenance, Finance, and HR) and ensure seamless day\-to\-day operations.
* Lead, motivate, and develop a team of 50–150\+ associates; conduct performance reviews, training programs, and succession planning.
* Deliver outstanding guest satisfaction scores (TripAdvisor, Google, internal surveys) and personally resolve escalated guest issues.
* Drive revenue through dynamic pricing, upselling strategies, corporate contracts, events, and banquet sales in coordination with the Sales \& Revenue team.
* Manage operating budgets, control costs (payroll, supplies, utilities), and achieve or exceed monthly and annual financial targets (RevPAR, GOP, ADR).
* Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, security, and compliance with local health, fire, and licensing regulations.
* Develop and execute annual marketing and business plans in collaboration with ownership or corporate office.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, travel agents, OTA partners, and local community stakeholders.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and guest feedback to recommend service and product improvements.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly management reports for ownership/corporate leadership.

Requirements \& QualificationsEducation

* Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or equivalent (Master’s preferred).

Experience

* Minimum 5–8 years of progressive hotel experience with at least 2–3 years as Hotel Manager or Assistant General Manager in a 50\+ room property.
* Proven track record in revenue management, cost control, and team leadership.

Skills \& Competencies

* Strong leadership and people\-management skills with ability to inspire teams.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (fluency in English \+ local language required).
* Proficient in Opera / Fidelio, PMS, POS systems, and Microsoft Office (especially Excel).
* Solid understanding of financial statements (P\&L, budgets, forecasting).
* High emotional intelligence and crisis\-management ability.
* Guest\-obsessed mindset with a hands\-on “roll\-up\-the\-sleeves” attitude.

Preferred

* Experience with international hotel brands (IHG, Marriott, Hilton, Accor, etc.).
* Certification in revenue management, food safety, or hospitality leadership programs.
* Working knowledge of labor laws and union environments (if applicable).

What We Offer

* Competitive salary \+ performance bonus (up to 20–30% of annual CTC).
* Comprehensive benefits package (health insurance, accommodation/meals, transport, gratuity).
* Career growth opportunities within the group.
* Free meals while on duty and uniform.
* Dynamic work environment in a fast\-growing hospitality company.

Reporting LineReports directly to: Owner / Regional Director / Area General Manager

If you are a results\-driven hospitality professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and loves creating memorable guest experiences, we want to hear from you!

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity.*

description:
Mechanical engineers are versatile professionals who research, design, develop, build, and test mechanical and thermal systems, ranging from micro\-scale sensors to massive industrial machinery. Their core responsibility is to bridge the gap between scientific principles (like physics and math) and practical applications to solve real\-world problems. * **Prototyping \& Testing**: Developing physical prototypes (often using 3D printing or CNC machining) and conducting methodical experiments to validate performance and safety.
* **Manufacturing Oversight**: Collaborating with production teams to oversee the fabrication process, ensuring designs are manufacturable (DFM) and meet quality standards.
* **Maintenance \& Troubleshooting**: Investigating equipment failures, performing root cause analysis, and recommending design modifications to prevent future malfunctions. Workable \+9

* **Education**: A **Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering** is the standard entry\-level requirement. A Master's degree is often preferred for specialized R\&D roles.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Strong grasp of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, materials science, and kinematics.

* **Soft Skills**: Problem\-solving, analytical thinking, creativity, and the ability to communicate complex technical data to non\-technical stakeholders. Betterteam \+8

* **Collaboration**: Working in multidisciplinary teams alongside electrical engineers, project managers, software developers, and manufacturing personnel. Bureau of Labor Statistics (.gov) \+4

title: PCB Design Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a versatile **CAD Engineer** to lead the physical design and layout of our advanced controller boards. You will be responsible for the full PCB lifecycle—from footprint creation to generating manufacturing\-ready Gerber/ODB\+\+ packages. The ideal candidate is a "power user" in **Altium Designer** for complex, high\-speed projects and is equally proficient in **KiCad** for agile, open\-hardware, or rapid\-prototyping initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Dual\-Platform Layout:** Execute high\-density, multi\-layer (4–10\+ layers) PCB designs in **Altium** and **KiCad**, selecting the best tool based on project requirements.
* **High\-Speed Routing:** Implement controlled impedance, differential pairs, and length\-matching for high\-speed buses (USB 2\.0/3\.0, SPI, and memory interfaces).
* **Library Management:** Build and maintain centralized component libraries (symbols, 3D STEP models, and footprints) compliant with **IPC\-7351** standards across both platforms.
* **Signal \& Power Integrity:** Perform basic SI/PI analysis to minimize crosstalk, EMI, and power\-rail noise, especially around sensitive **RFID/NFC frontends**.
* **DFM/DFA/DFT:** Conduct thorough **Design for Manufacturing** and **Assembly** reviews to ensure high yields and lower production costs at EMS providers.
* **MCAD Collaboration:** Coordinate with mechanical engineers to ensure PCB\-to\-Enclosure fitment using **Altium 365** or **KiCad’s STEP export** features.

**Technical Skills \& Qualifications**

* **EDA Expertise:** 6 months of experience with **Altium Designer** (Unified environment, ActiveBOM) and **KiCad** (Version 7\.0/8\.0\).
* **PCB Technology:** Expertise in **HDI (High\-Density Interconnect)**, micro\-vias, and complex layer stack\-up definitions.
* **RF Awareness:** Familiarity with PCB antenna design and isolation techniques for **NXP RFID/NFC** chipsets.
* **Standards:** Strong knowledge of **IPC\-2221** (Design) and **IPC\-610** (Acceptability).
* **Version Control:** Proficiency in using **Git** for managing KiCad project files and **Altium 365** for cloud\-based versioning.

title: freelance wordpress developer
description:
1\. Position Overview

The WordPress Developer will be a part of the web development team and will assist in the design, development, customization, optimization, and maintenance of WordPress\-based websites and applications. This internship is designed to provide hands\-on, real\-world experience in WordPress development while working under the guidance of experienced developers and project managers.

The intern will gain exposure to modern web development practices, content management systems (CMS), front\-end and back\-end development concepts, website performance optimization, security best practices, and collaborative software development workflows. This role is ideal for students or recent graduates who are passionate about web technologies and eager to build a strong foundation in WordPress development.

2\. Key Objectives of the Internship

* To provide practical experience in developing and managing WordPress websites
* To help interns understand real\-world project workflows and development lifecycles

* To develop problem\-solving, debugging, and optimization skills
* To enhance collaboration and communication skills within a professional development team

3\. Roles and Responsibilities3\.1 WordPress Development

* Assist in building, customizing, and maintaining WordPress websites based on project requirements
* Work with WordPress themes (both pre\-built and custom themes) to implement UI/UX designs
* Customize WordPress plugins and develop basic custom plugins when required
* Support the integration of third\-party tools, APIs, and plugins
* Implement responsive design principles to ensure compatibility across devices and browsers

3\.2 Front\-End Development Support

* Write clean, well\-structured HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript code
* Assist in converting design mockups (Figma, Adobe XD, PSD) into functional WordPress pages
* Optimize website layouts for performance, usability, and accessibility
* Make UI enhancements based on user feedback and testing results

3\.3 Back\-End and CMS Support

* Assist in configuring WordPress core settings, custom post types, taxonomies, and fields
* Support PHP\-based WordPress customization tasks under supervision
* Help manage databases (MySQL) related to WordPress installations
* Participate in content migration, data imports, and backups

3\.4 Website Performance and Optimization

* Assist in optimizing website speed and performance using caching, image optimization, and best practices
* Identify and resolve basic performance bottlenecks
* Support SEO\-friendly development practices such as clean URLs, schema markup, and metadata integration

3\.5 Security and Maintenance

* Assist in implementing WordPress security best practices
* Help update WordPress core, themes, and plugins while ensuring site stability
* Monitor websites for common vulnerabilities and issues
* Participate in routine maintenance tasks and quality assurance testing

3\.6 Testing and Debugging

* Conduct functional, UI, and cross\-browser testing
* Identify bugs, errors, and inconsistencies and assist in resolving them
* Use debugging tools and browser developer tools to troubleshoot issues
* Document issues clearly for senior developers

3\.7 Collaboration and Documentation

* Work closely with designers, developers, content creators, and project managers
* Participate in daily or weekly stand\-ups, sprint meetings, and project discussions
* Maintain clear documentation for development tasks, changes, and workflows
* Follow coding standards, version control practices, and internal development guidelines

4\. Required Skills and Technical Knowledge4\.1 Core Technical Skills

* Basic to intermediate understanding of WordPress CMS
* Familiarity with WordPress themes, plugins, and dashboard functionality
* Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and basic JavaScript
* Basic understanding of PHP and how it is used in WordPress
* Familiarity with MySQL databases and CMS\-driven websites

4\.2 Tools and Technologies

* WordPress (latest versions)
* Code editors such as VS Code, Sublime Text, or similar
* Version control systems (Git/GitHub or GitLab – basic knowledge preferred)
* Page builders such as Elementor, Gutenberg, or WPBakery (optional but advantageous)

4\.3 Soft Skills

* Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality work
* Ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines
* Good communication skills (written and verbal)
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment

5\. Educational Qualifications

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in:
* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Web Development
* Software Engineering
* Or a related technical field
* Candidates from non\-technical backgrounds with demonstrable WordPress and web development skills are also encouraged to apply

6\. Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

* Prior experience with WordPress projects (academic, freelance, or personal)
* Basic knowledge of SEO concepts and digital marketing integration
* Familiarity with REST APIs and third\-party integrations
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG)
* Exposure to hosting environments, cPanel, or cloud hosting platforms

7\. Learning Outcomes and Growth Opportunities

By the end of the internship, the WordPress Developer Intern is expected to:

* Gain hands\-on experience in developing and managing live WordPress websites
* Understand professional development workflows and best practices
* Build a strong portfolio of WordPress\-based projects
* Improve coding, debugging, and optimization skills
* Develop confidence in working with clients, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams

High\-performing interns may be considered for:

* Internship extension
* Part\-time or full\-time WordPress Developer roles
* Advanced responsibilities on client and internal projects

8\. Performance Evaluation Criteria

Intern performance will be evaluated based on:

* Quality and accuracy of assigned development tasks

Regular feedback sessions will be conducted to support continuous improvement.

9\. Work Environment and Culture

10\. Internship Benefits

Interested candidates should submit:

description:
**About the company:**

CognoSpace is an activity\-based educational solutions developer that prioritizes **experiential learning**. Our curriculum caters to the entire spectrum of STEAM learning purely through activities. To deliver such a curriculum we partner with schools in creating smart experiential learning labs with modern infrastructure, that includes state\-of\-the\-art Science, Math, Engineering equipment, and technology like AI, Drones, Automation, Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality, and 3D Designing/Printing.

**Who can Apply:**  
**Engineering in any Stream**  
**Interested in Robotics Trainer**   
**Freshers Welcome**

**Salary: 3\-3\.5LPA**

**About the role:**

**STEM Educator** will play a pivotal role in supporting the operations and activities of CognoSpace at the school, a physical modern **educational space** where high school students engage in **hands\-on science experiments,** and technology\-based learning using **Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality** tools. This individual will provide technical expertise, guidance, and assistance to students in delivering our curriculum, ensuring a safe and productive learning environment. He /She will be responsible for facilitating curriculum execution, and be a **liaison between the company and the school.**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Curriculum Delivery:** End\-to\-end content delivery and classroom management. Assist students in performing science experiments using CognoSpace STEM kits. Ability to use and deliver proprietary AR/VR content, AI topics, Technologies like Drones and IoT, 3D Printing
* **Managing Space:** Be the support in coordinating the entire execution process through maintenance of premises, equipment, educational tools. Collaborate with school staff and management in ensuring smooth execution of the curriculum.
* **Equipment Maintenance:** Regularly inspect, maintain, and troubleshoot lab equipment to ensure safe and optimal functionality. Coordinate repairs or replacements with the product team as needed.
* **Safety and Compliance:** Enforce safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a secure environment for students and promote responsible use of tools and equipment.
* **Resource Management:** Manage and organize the inventory of tools, supplies, and materials in the lab. Maintain accurate records of equipment usage and inventory levels.
* **Documentation and Evaluation:** Maintain comprehensive record of lesson plan execution and outcomes using CognoSpace Mobile App or the web application.
* **School Engagement:** Actively engage with student activities at schools such as parent days, sports days, science fairs, etc. to promote the CognoSpace brand by supporting stalls, workshops and the overall lab program.
* **Feedback:** Evaluate the effectiveness of lab activities and the curriculum. Provide feedback to the CognoSpace product development team and propose improvements.
* **Training (Future proposition):** Take on the role of a trainer to mentor and train new lab specialists, providing guidance on effective support techniques, technical knowledge, best practices and safety protocols.

**Qualifications Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering
* Prior teaching experience is a plus.
* Experience working in a collaborative environment like laboratories/tinker\-labs/STEM labs/Computer labs lab, laboratory, or science\-related environment is a plus.
* Freshers are encouraged if they come with an Engineering Background
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with students, teachers, parents, and school management.
* Experience in Robotics labs, Makerspace will be a plus.
* Leverage company mobile APP and digital content for end\-to\-end delivery and classroom management.
* Assist students in performing activities using CognoSpace STEM kits, Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality \& 3D Printing.
* The Initial salary pay range will be from 3 LPA .

**Training:**

**2\-3 weeks of training will be offered upon joining and before deployment in schools.**

Emmes Group was founded as Emmes more than 47 years ago, becoming one of the primary clinical research providers to the US government before expanding into public\-private partnerships and commercial biopharma.  to join the Human Resources department. We are growing fast—not just in headcount, but in complexity. title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**About Freshlynn** 




  





 Freshlynn — Clean Smarter. Live Fresher.
 



  





 Freshlynn is India's first manufacturer of 4\-in\-1 Laundry Drops — a single drop that cleans, softens, brightens, and freshens your clothes. Born in Gujarat, built for the world.
 



  





 We didn't just create a product. We created a category. While the detergent industry has remained unchanged for decades, Freshlynn is rewriting the rules — delivering ultra\-concentrated, pre\-measured, zero\-waste laundry technology that is smarter, cleaner, and better for the planet.
 



  





 Today, we are India's fastest\-growing direct\-to\-consumer laundry brand, selling across India through our online store.
 



 Tomorrow, Freshlynn will be on the shelves of every kirana store (GT), every supermarket and hypermarket (MT), and in the homes of consumers across the globe.
 



  





 Our ambition is clear — to build an Indian consumer goods company that stands alongside the world's greatest FMCG giants. We are building the team, the systems, and the brand to get there.
 



  





 If you want to be part of India's most exciting laundry revolution — you're in the right place.
 



  




* Manufacturer \| D2C Online \| GT \& MT Expansion \| Global Vision \| Made in India



  





 Digital Marketing Manager — eCommerce \& Performance
 



 Full Time \| Ahmedabad, Gujarat \| eCommerce · FMCG
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are looking for a results\-driven Digital Marketing Manager to lead and scale Freshlynn's online presence across all digital channels. You will own our Meta Ads performance, content strategy, and brand growth — working directly with the founder to take India's first 4\-in\-1 Laundry Drops brand to the next level.
 



  





 This is a high\-impact, high\-ownership role in a fast\-growing D2C brand. If you love building brands from the ground up, obsess over ROAS, and want to be part of something truly first\-of\-its\-kind in India — this role is for you.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL DO
 



 • Plan, execute, and optimize Meta (Facebook \& Instagram) ad campaigns with a strong focus on ROAS and cost per purchase
 



 • Manage monthly ad budget of ₹5–15 lakhs across multiple campaigns
 



 • Build and manage retargeting, lookalike, and conversion campaigns end\-to\-end
 



 • Lead the content calendar — coordinating with designers and video editors for ad creatives
 



 • Analyze Shopify sales data and Meta Ads Manager performance daily and take action
 



 • Manage Google Ads, SEO, email and WhatsApp marketing campaigns
 



 • Track key metrics: ROAS, CPM, CTR, cost per purchase, return rate, and net revenue
 



 • Identify and fix funnel leaks — from ad impression to final purchase
 



 • Build and manage a small in\-house marketing team (designer, video editor, ads buyer)
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




 • 2–4 years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in D2C or eCommerce brands
 



 • Proven track record of managing Meta Ads with ROAS above 3x
 



 • Strong knowledge of Shopify analytics, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Analytics
 



 • Experience managing monthly budgets of ₹3 lakhs or more
 



 • Ability to write compelling ad copy and brief creative teams
 



 • Data\-driven mindset — you make decisions based on numbers, not guesses
 



 • Self\-starter who can work independently and take full ownership
 



 • Bonus: Experience in FMCG, home care, or consumer goods brands
 



  





 WHAT WE OFFER
 



 • Salary: ₹25,000 – ₹45,000 per month (based on experience)
 



 • Direct mentorship from the founder
 



 • Opportunity to build and lead your own team
 



 • Be part of India's first 4\-in\-1 Laundry Drops company — a true category creator

description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
   

  

 Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
   

  

**About The Position**
 The Technical Writer is part of the Information Management team and plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between potentially complex technical information and the end users who need to understand and use it. They are responsible for creating clear and concise documentation such as production, maintenance and laboratory procedures, safety procedures, equipment manuals, and training materials. Their expertise lies in translating potentially intricate technical concepts into accessible language, ensuring that all content is accurate, up\-to\-date. Collaborating closely with engineers, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders, Technical Writers ensure the integrity of the documentation, which is critical for the safe and efficient operation of LNG facilities..
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintenance of all facility production, maintenance and laboratory Operating Procedures, Work Instructions and Process \& Equipment Manuals, as well as HSE and Process Safety Manuals and Reports.
* Generate materials with input from SMEs and ensure that all documents are developed for their intended audience.
* Research engineering documentation, diagrams, corporate standards, and other regulations and standards to ensure sufficient compliance.
* Ensure that impact from MOCs, HAZOPs and other ABU processes are adequately captured and reflected in all affected documents.
* Ensure technical documents adhere to industry standards including Human and Organisation Performance (HOP) principles


**About You**
 5\+ years of relevant experience providing technical writing support and for a Complex Processing Facility (CPF) operating environment such as a Liquified Natural Gas (LNG) Facility, Refinery or Chemicals facility.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B. Tech) in relevant engineering discipline (mechanical, process, etc..) from a recognized (AICTE) university or trade/craft background
* High level of skill using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Visio and SharePoint, as well as Adobe Professional

description:
**Who We Are**
 Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting\-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Location:
   

  

 Bangalore,IND
   

  

 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
   

  

 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
   

  

 Software Technical Writer
   

  

**Description**
 Applied Materials, Inc., is the global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality.
   

  

 Our SmartFactory Solutions software team is seeking an experienced and self\-motivated Technical Writer. In this role, you will excel at analyzing complex information and translating that into clear written and visual instructions for our customers. You will work with our geographically distributed software team, developing solutions for the semiconductor fabrication and assembly, test, packaging industries. Our planning and productivity solutions enable our customers to automate, monitor, and optimize their factory operations.
   

  

**Experience \- 7 To 10 Years**
 What you’ll be doing
   

  

 As a Technical Writer on our team, you’ll be responsible for:
   

  

* Reviewing and contributing to software design specifications that describe product enhancements and changes.
* Collaborating closely with software engineers, product managers, customer support, and quality assurance teams to gather product information.
* Installing and using software both locally and in virtual machine environments to explore and document software features.
* Creating diagrams and screenshots to help users understand software architecture and features.
* Authoring online Help, release notes, and installation instructions with clear overviews and easy\-to\-follow procedures.
* Ensuring technically accurate, high\-quality product documentation that meets requirements and is delivered on\-time.


 What we’re looking for
   

  

 Key requirements for this position include:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering.
* Four or more years writing experience, preferably in the software industry.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt your writing to conform to a corporate style guide.
* Adept at interviewing subject matter experts to gather the information needed to generate best\-in\-class content.
* Close attention to detail and strong multitasking abilities.
* General knowledge of software systems and a desire to understand software features.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a distributed team.


 What will give you an edge
   

  

 Additional skills that would make you stand out for this position include:
   

  

* Familiarity with the Microsoft Writing Style Guide.
* Experience working in an agile environment and using Jira for ticket progress tracking.
* Experience with the MadCap Flare Help authoring tool.
* Familiarity with UNIX or command\-line applications.
* Experience with version control systems (such as Git).


 Join our team and contribute to the success of our industry\-leading software solutions. Apply now!
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Time Type:**
 Full time
   

  

**Employee Type:**
 Assignee / Regular
   

  

**Travel:**
 Not Specified
   

  

**Relocation Eligible:**
 Yes

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

description:
**Job Description**
 Take a lead role in acquiring, managing and retaining meaningful relationships that deliver outstanding experience to our customers. In this role, you will balance your focus on business results by offering options and finding solutions to help our customers with issues.
   

  

 As a Subject Matter Expert (SME) within the team, you implement readiness strategies across multiple lines of business, including Card and Auto Ops Service. Demonstrate an ability to raise issues to relevant stakeholders or leadership with respect to anticipated impacts on customer specialists and Chase overall.
   

  

 You will be expected to manage change requests received via Change Manager. Partner with servicing lines of business to drive change, process improvements, and improve the customer and specialists' experience. You are expected to complete impact assessments and assign change requests via Change Manager. You may lead high\-profile projects across multiple lines of business.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Recognized as an expert aligned to one or more Lines of Business (LOB) and complete impact assessments on changes to identify operational impacts on processes and procedures.
* Identify and provide solutions for needed process improvements, efficiencies, control risks, and gaps.
* Assign change requests based on capacity to business analysts.
* Lead large\-scale projects/initiatives/change requests.
* Proactively influence stakeholders using problem solving skills to course correct when issues arise


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Auto and Card procedures and processes.
* Ability to lead through change and drive outcomes based on competing priorities.
* Proven ability to lead large, complex cross\-LOB projects and drive execution of project deliverables.
* Holds oneself and others accountable for achieving project goals and deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to communicate and interact effectively with all levels of the business.
* Demonstrate ability to raise issues to relevant stakeholders or leadership and drive triage and issue resolution.
* Ability to facilitate strategic discussions in large forums with senior leaders.
* Demonstrate outstanding attention to detail and ability to learn complex processes.
* Ability to analyze and apply policy requirements to existing and proposed procedures and processes.
* Ability to be flexible, adhere to tight deadlines, organize and prioritize work in a constantly changing environment


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Experience with process improvement and project management methodology preferred.
* Competent organizational skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to deal with highly confidential information in a professional manner.
* Adapts well to increasing scope and complexity of work brought on by business growth.


**Additional Details**
* Schedule: Monday through Friday, 04:30 PM to 01:30 AM Indian Standard Time.
* Visa Sponsorship: This role does not offer visa sponsorship.
* Work Arrangement: In office 100%

title: Business Analyst, RBS : Cost to Serve
description:
**Description**
 About Amazon
   

  

 Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Through continuous innovation in selection, convenience, and low prices, Amazon has grown from an online bookstore into a global e\-commerce and technology leader. Our teams build solutions that improve how customers shop, how sellers grow, and how our global supply chain operates.
   

  

**About Retail Business Services (RBS)**
 RBS strengthens Amazon’s retail engine by driving standardization, improving process quality, and reducing defects across global marketplaces. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon’s systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.
   

  

**About Cost To Serve (CtS)**
 CtS is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon’s per\-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination, and partners with WW Operations, Finance, Returns, Concessions, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true cost drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high\-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.
   

  

 Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision\-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable dashboards, reporting systems, and automated data pipelines that support business reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR), pilot launches, and ongoing program governance.
* Own data infrastructure end\-to\-end—partner with tech, analytics, and operations teams to establish and maintain required tables, data lakes, and data structures that enable accurate and timely insights for APIE and related stakeholders.
* Retrieve, aggregate, and analyze data from multiple sources to produce actionable insights, KPI frameworks, and escalation deep dives that inform feature expansion, defect identification, and strategic decision\-making.
* Develop and maintain SQL queries and analytical models to support APIE feature performance, ad\-hoc requests, and dive\-deep investigations for operational or customer/vendor escalations.
* Enable data\-driven decision making by converting large datasets into digestible narratives, financial/CX estimates, and recommendations for pilots, experiments, and global expansions.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, build KPIs, automate processes, and drive data\-aligned solutions that meet evolving business needs.
* Prepare and deliver business reviews and written narratives for senior leadership, highlighting progress, insights, risks, and decision points.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions, providing analytical input that shapes long\-term product and operations strategy across global regions.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* 5\+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* 3\+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* 2\+ years of Tableau Desktop, Quicksight or other relevant data visualization software experience
* Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field, or experience in financial modeling, P\&L management or analysis
* Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in business or analytical discipline

In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.
